name: Echo of Nozdormu reduces known spell cooldowns on cast (#5555)
contract: #5555: Echo of Nozdormu 802174's Description reads 'reducing all spell and ability cooldowns by $802804s1%' (802804 effect 0..2 are the custom effect 192 -- BasePoints 4, DieSides 1, value 5 -- targeting caster with EffectMiscValue 504380/500135/806611). 802804 itself has no spell_script_names binding and effect 192 has no core handler ('safe null handler' per SharedDefines.h), so that specific 3-spell path is dead. But pyromancer_spells::OnSpellCast (AscensionPyromancerAbilities.cpp) already has an unconditional block for Named(info, 802174) that iterates the caster's whole spellbook and reduces every known spell's remaining cooldown by the same 5% (percent = 5, matching 802804's calculated value; +extra with 802168 Aspect's Blessing, not used here) via ModifySpellCooldown -- literally 'all spell and ability cooldowns', which is broader than 802804's 3-spell list. Adding the 802804/effect-192 wiring on top would double-reduce those 3 spells, so no code change is made here; this scenario proves the already-shipped mechanism delivers the tooltip's reduction using Draconic Invocation (802119, RecoveryTime 180000 ms, no SpellFamily overlap with the 3 listed spells) as an unrelated long-cooldown probe.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Put Draconic Invocation on its 180 s cooldown
Let the shared GCD from Draconic Invocation clear
control: Draconic Invocation is on cooldown
Draconic Invocation's cooldown drops by about 5%, not by natural decay alone
